title: bartonia paniculata var. iodandra
intro: Bartonia paniculata var. iodandra, commonly known as the Yellow Panicle or Iodandra, is a plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. It is native to North America, particularly in the southeastern United States. The Yellow Panicle plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include promoting health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory actions, and supporting the immune system. The plant's bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory effects.
